name: ecommerce-abandoned-checkout-filament
description: The operator's view of a checkout that was begun and not finished: what was in it, every attempt to reach out about it, and — on a fresh install, where nothing is bound — the reason nothing has gone.
features: An attempt that did not go renders the refusal that stopped it, never an empty row: a fresh install where nothing is bound reads as the joint that is not attached rather than as nothing to do
All thirteen refusal reasons the domain publishes have a sentence, and a new one is a hole in a match rather than a blank on a screen
Nothing heard is rendered as three answers and not as a blank: not yet, never will, and no way to know, the last being what a bound channel that reports nothing back actually leaves behind
The outreach screen names which seam is unbound before an attempt refuses, so an operator sees the cause rather than inferring it from an absence
An amount is placed by the exponent the domain stores beside it, so 2500 GBP renders as 25.00 and 2500 JPY as 2500, and no screen hard-codes a currency or divides by a hundred
The state an abandonment has reached is derived and is shown as derived: there is no filter and no sort on it, because no column exists for the database to index
The stored half of that state, the stop reason, is the one thing filtered and sorted on, because it is a column
Every widget overrides canView and states the tenant in its own query, because a widget is the surface Filament's own tenancy does not reach and canView defaults to true

Both widgets are constructed by the suite and asserted through a public accessor returning structured rows, which is the test the host never had and the reason its store-scoped widget error was invisible to CI
One clock is read per request in one file, and every window, delay and expiry on the page is measured from it
The whole page reads the domain once through a per-request snapshot rather than each widget resolving the same queries
Neither header action carries a visible guard, because Filament re-evaluates one against a freshly hydrated record and a guard would make the domain's own refusal unreachable
No contact reference and no subject reference appears on any listing, and a redacted one renders as a fact rather than as a blank
There is no create, edit or delete control anywhere: an abandonment is a statement about a moment that has passed, and a campaign is changed by defining it again
Every condition field and every comparison is a select over a domain enum, so a field the module does not publish cannot be entered from this panel at all
A campaign whose stored conditions are malformed renders the refusal an attempt would receive, rather than raising on the screen
Nothing in this package writes through Eloquent: every write is a published domain action taking the tenant as its first argument
Every custody check is keyed on the row rather than on a reference two merchants can both hold
Another merchant's abandonment or campaign and one that does not exist raise the same exception on every screen
Every count over a restated relation is asserted at its right non-zero value, because a guarded restatement that reports zero looks exactly like isolation working
This panel offers neither the cross-tenant export nor the cross-tenant erasure, because a screen scoped to one merchant must not carry a control that spans every merchant
There is no control that records an outcome, because an outcome is an observation and a panel button is not one
There is no control that records an abandonment, because deciding a checkout was abandoned belongs to whatever owns the checkout
